title: Sensitivity Analysis in Population Shares
abstract: arXiv:2611.05584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empirical work often relies on assumptions on the distribution of random variables, such as potential outcomes or latent variables, to identify some parameter of interest. We introduce a unified framework for assessing the sensitivity of a target estimand to relaxing these distributional assumptions for a given share of the population. We derive bounds on the values the estimand can take as this share varies between 0 and 1, and compute the bounds using tractable finite-dimensional programs. We propose plug-in estimators for the bounds and characterize their large sample properties. We also show that our bounds recover exact nonparametric sharp bounds at no additional computational cost, and introduce summary measures that separate misspecification uncertainty from sampling uncertainty and rank studies by their robustness. translated_title: 总体比例的敏感性分析
translated_abstract: 实证研究通常依赖于对随机变量（如潜在结果或潜变量）分布的假设，以识别某个感兴趣的参数。我们引入了一个统一框架，用于评估当对总体中给定比例的个体放松这些分布假设时，目标估计量的敏感性。我们推导了当该比例在0到1之间变化时估计量可能取值的边界，并使用易于求解的有限维规划来计算这些边界。我们提出了边界的代入估计量，并刻画了其大样本性质。我们还证明，我们的边界能够以零额外计算成本恢复精确的非参数尖锐边界，并引入了能够将模型误设不确定性与抽样不确定性分离的汇总度量，以及按稳健性对研究进行排序的方法。我们将该框架应用于评估以下问题的稳健性：（i）存在样本流失的随机实验中的平均处理效应……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的敏感性分析框架，通过可求解的有限维规划计算边界，量化当放松总体中一定比例个体的分布假设时目标估计量的敏感性，并提供区分模型误设不确定性与抽样不确定性的汇总度量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified sensitivity analysis framework that derives tractable bounds, computed via finite-dimensional programs, to quantify how sensitive a target estimand is to relaxing distributional assumptions for a given share of the population, along with summary measures that separate misspecification uncertainty from sampling uncertainty.
